derivative_work.count_source: Exact traversal census for this fixture, including repeated-shell orbit degeneracies; native s/p tests independently count actual callbacks. Not a count of nonzero primitive records or kernel launches.

Exact traversal census for this fixture, including repeated-shell orbit degeneracies; native s/p tests independently count actual callbacks. Not a count of nonzero primitive records or kernel launches.

limitations: The public native CCSD(T) force boundary is 28 AOs; CCSD and the Python complete-gradient validation owner retain their separate 12-AO boundaries.
Node2 experimental 56-AO forces failed the canonical occupied/virtual subspace degeneracy gate (job 2066); no 56-AO force support or speedup is established.
CPU/GPU nodes were shared and timing pairs were separate executions. Affinity differs between the 28-AO CPU comparator and candidate.
Memcheck timings are retained but excluded from normal performance comparisons.
Public cc_performance counters describe the preceding energy solve; native force-provider counters are checked by resource tests and derivative work is an exact traversal census.
CUDA remains a composed endpoint with host triples response, GMRES control and MO-to-AO weight preparation; it is not fully device resident.

reference.settings: Exact repository STO-3G, spherical, all electron, no frozen core; corrected CCSD(T) Lambda; reference generator records the complete tolerances.

row_encoding: For each category, merge common_row_defaults, record.row_defaults and the row dictionary, in that order; later entries override earlier defaults. All observations are retained.
timing_boundary: Each prepared.execute(properties=(energy,forces)) call, including the complete reference, CCSD, triples, corrected Lambda, Hamiltonian/orbital response and nuclear derivative. Preparation is recorded separately; no kernel-only timings are used as endpoint speedups.
